thread:
jordan: heads-up: scheduling a coordinated rollout in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window tomorrow. major parts: api (v2.2.0), runtime (rc-7), router (v3.3.0), console UI toggle. need green from each owner before /deploy kicks off.

neha: runtime rc-7 passed perf bench but we saw a small increase in p95 for long sequences when router header-split is enabled. i suggest disabling header-split on the router during initial ramp.

ryan: api v2.2.0 includes the new streaming handshake. will gate with a canary that allows 10% traffic to v2.2.0 and keep v2.1.x as fallback. traffic pinning plan in the runbook.

emi: console changes are client-side only; i'll keep the rollout behind feature-flag: console_ui_v2. full rollout only after 3 consecutive canary intervals pass. screenshots & audit notes will be in the doc.

jordan: okay, operational checklist proposal:
1) preflight 01:30 UTC: verify infra reserved (gpu-pool-4) and confirm deploy-bot locks window.
2) 02:00: runtime rc-7 -> warm servers (warmup 12m). run cache-warm job.
3) 02:15: router v3.3.0 with header-split=false. smoke test routing.
4) 02:25: api v2.2.0 canary 10% -> monitor 10m intervals.
5) 02:45: console feature flag 10% -> monitor visual errors.
6) ramp per release-bot schedule to 100% by 03:30 if all gates pass.

deploy-bot: ack. planned invocation:
```
/deploy schedule --start=02:00 --end=03:30 --order=runtime,router,api,console --id=rel-4815551
```

neha: warmup commands i'll run:
```
kubectl scale deployment/runtime --replicas=12
jobs/run-cache-warm --seqs=128,512 --duration=600
```

ryan: canary rollback criteria for api: if error-rate >0.4% sustained for 5m OR streaming handshake errors >2%, then /deploy rollback api --to v2.1.x --tag rel-4815551. also add header logs to the tracing dashboard for quick triage.

emi: console rollback: flip `console_ui_v2` off, purge CDN edge cache, pin frontend to commit 9f3b2a. will attach revert steps to the runbook.

jordan: router fallback rule: keep old router binary available as pinned variant. if routing p99 > 600ms or token-drop events observed, revert header-split flag to true and roll router back. rollback command: `/deploy rollback router --to v3.2.9 --tag rel-4815551`.

release-bot: automated ramp: 10% @ +10m, 30% @ +30m, 60% @ +60m, 100% @ +90m relative to individual component start. health gates: p99 latency, 5xx rate, token-drop, memory OOMs. will abort on gate failure.

neha: i'll post live warmup logs and a short diff of kernel flags once warmup completes. tail command: `kubectl logs -l app=runtime -f --tail=200`.

ryan: i updated the release notes draft: https://redwood.intranet/releases/rel-4815551-draft. includes schema diff, streaming handshake notes, rollout timings, and rollback steps.

emi: quick question: do we need a DB migration window? it's zero-downtime but i added a preflight migration validation step at 01:40.

jordan: yes include migration validation. also ops, please confirm you have capacity to handle a manual abort and that the runbook is reachable.

deploy-bot: will emit heartbeat every 5m during the window and will pause ramp on any manual `hold` signal. sample abort: `/deploy abort --id=rel-4815551 --reason="health-gate-failed"`.

neha: ack from runtime side. will disable header-split at router path during canary and re-enable after full ramp if stable. :white_check_mark:

ryan: api ready for 10% canary. pinned traffic rule created. :thumbsup:

emi: console flagged for 10% visual rollout. runbook link added. :eyes:

jordan: thanks — i'll pin this thread and tidy the runbook. set alarms for the health gates and add the temporary header-split flag note. see you in the window.
